350tommy_inline void tommy_list_insert_before(tommy_list* list, tommy_node* reference, tommy_node* node, void* data)
351{
352 tommy_node* head = tommy_list_head(list);
353
354 /* if inserting before the head, update the list pointer */
355 if (head == reference) {
356 tommy_list_insert_head_not_empty(list, node);
357 } else {
358 /* insert in the "circular" prev list */
359 node->prev = reference->prev;
360 reference->prev = node;
361
362 /* insert in the "0 terminated" next list */
363 node->next = reference;
364 node->prev->next = node;
365 }
366
367 node->data = data;
368}
369
377tommy_inline void tommy_list_insert_after(tommy_list* list, tommy_node* reference, tommy_node* node, void* data)
378{
379 tommy_node* head = tommy_list_head(list);
380
381 /* if inserting after the tail (reference->next == 0), handle specially */
382 if (reference->next == 0) {
383 tommy_list_insert_tail_not_empty(head, node);
384 } else {
385 /* insert in the "circular" prev list */
386 node->prev = reference;
387 reference->next->prev = node;
388
389 /* insert in the "0 terminated" next list */
390 node->next = reference->next;
391 reference->next = node;
392 }
393
394 node->data = data;
395}

406tommy_inline void* tommy_list_remove_existing(tommy_list* list, tommy_node* node)
407{
408 tommy_node* head = tommy_list_head(list);
409
410 /* remove from the "circular" prev list */
411 if (node->next)
412 node->next->prev = node->prev;
413 else
414 head->prev = node->prev; /* the last */
415
416 /* remove from the "0 terminated" next list */
417 if (head == node)
418 *list = node->next; /* the new head, in case 0 */
419 else
420 node->prev->next = node->next;
421
422 return node->data;
423}

430tommy_inline void* tommy_list_remove_head(tommy_list* list)
431{
432 tommy_node* node = tommy_list_head(list);
433
434 if (!node)
435 return 0;
436
437 /* the new head must retain the tail pointer in the "circular" prev list */
438 if (node->next)
439 node->next->prev = node->prev;
440
441 *list = node->next;
442
443 return node->data;
444}

451tommy_inline void* tommy_list_remove_tail(tommy_list* list)
452{
453 tommy_node* head = tommy_list_head(list);
454
455 if (!head)
456 return 0;
457
458 tommy_node* node = head->prev;
459
460 /* a single node is also the head, and its links must remain unchanged */
461 if (node == head) {
462 *list = 0;
463 } else {
464 head->prev = node->prev;
465 node->prev->next = 0;
466 }
467
468 return node->data;
469}

518tommy_inline void tommy_list_split(tommy_list* list, tommy_node* node, tommy_list* second)
519{
520 tommy_node* head = tommy_list_head(list);
521 tommy_node* tail;
522 tommy_node* before;
523
524 if (!node) {
525 *second = 0;
526 return;
527 }
528
529 if (node == head) {
530 *second = *list;
531 *list = 0;
532 return;
533 }
534
535 tail = head->prev;
536 before = node->prev;
537
538 /* terminate the retained list */
539 head->prev = before;
540 before->next = 0;
541
542 /* create the list of transferred nodes */
543 node->prev = tail;
544 *second = node;
545}

571tommy_inline void tommy_list_concat(tommy_list* first, tommy_list* second)
572{
573 /* if the second is empty, nothing to do */
574 tommy_node* second_head = tommy_list_head(second);
575 if (second_head == 0)
576 return;
577
578 /* if the first is empty, copy the second */
579 tommy_node* first_head = tommy_list_head(first);
580 if (first_head == 0) {
581 *first = *second;
582 return;
583 }
584
585 /* tail of the first list */
586 tommy_node* first_tail = first_head->prev;
587
588 /* set the "circular" prev list */
589 first_head->prev = second_head->prev;
590 second_head->prev = first_tail;
591
592 /* set the "0 terminated" next list */
593 first_tail->next = second_head;
594}

604tommy_inline void tommy_list_concat_builder(tommy_list* list, const tommy_builder* builder, tommy_node* tail)
605{
606 tommy_node* head = builder->dummy.next;
607
608 if (!head)
609 return;
610
611 tommy_node* first = *list;
612
613 /* replace the sentinel link so no list node refers to the temporary builder */
614 if (first) {
615 tommy_node* first_tail = first->prev;
616 first_tail->next = head;
617 head->prev = first_tail;
618 first->prev = tail;
619 } else {
620 *list = head;
621 head->prev = tail;
622 }
623
624 tail->next = 0;
625}

635tommy_inline void tommy_list_prepend(tommy_list* first, tommy_list* second)
636{
637 tommy_list_concat(second, first);
638 *first = *second;

723{
